# The KHIT Blog

> > A wide-ranging commentary blog covering healthcare IT, clinical workflows, EHR systems, and contemporary political/social issues including international conflicts and U.S. policy.

Written primarily by BobbyG, this blog bridges healthcare information technology topics (EHR optimization, ICD-10, health data standards) with broader commentary on geopolitics, domestic policy, and personal reflections. The site evolved from its Regional Extension Center origins to encompass diverse critical analysis.

## Key Topics

- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Clinical Workflow Optimization
- Healthcare IT Standards (ASC X12, ICD-10)
- Meaningful Use & Health Data
- Russia-Ukraine War
- Political Commentary (Trump Administration)
- Healthcare Reform & Single-Payer
- International Conflicts (Gaza, Iran, Israel)
- Immigration & Refugee Policy
- Big Data & Personalized Medicine
- Health Information Management (AHIMA)
- Healthcare Security & Privacy
- Coding Bootcamps & Software Engineering
- Climate Crisis & Water Shortages
- Christian Nationalism Critique

## Healthcare IT & Clinical Workflows

- ["Fix the EHR?" Of course, but how about fixing the clinical process workflows?](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2018/04/fix-ehr-of-course-but-how-about-fixing.html): EHR optimization via Lean methodology at Mayo Clinic for workflow improvement
- [Clinical workflow: "YAWL," y'all?](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2014/11/clincal-workflow-yawl-yall.html): YAWL workflow language for EHR usability and clinical process patterns
- ["Big Data"? How about REALLY Big Data? "Personalized" to EACH of us?](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2012/11/big-data-how-about-really-big-data.html): Big data and personalized medicine via Meaningful Use and genomics analysis

## Healthcare Standards & Policy

- [We in the U.S. just want health care "PLANS," not actual health care, I guess](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2025/12/we-want-health-care-plans-not-actual.html): Healthcare reform critique via JD Kleinke on Obamacare and single-payer
- [The ASC X12 834 005010X220/005010X220A1 Lonesome Highway Blues](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2013/11/the-asc-x12-834-005010x220005010x220a1.html): ACA enrollment EDI transaction issues with HealthCare.gov ASC X12 834 errors
- [ICD-10: Be Very Afraid](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2015/01/icd-10-be-very-afraid.html): ICD-10 implementation fears and provider readiness concerns per AHIMA
- ["We value the trust and confidence that you place with BCBSRI..."](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2015/03/we-value-trust-and-confidence-that-you.html): BCBSRI Anthem breach notification letter critique on security failures
- [Are we about to descend into mass national psychosis?](https://regionalextensioncenter.blogspot.com/2014/10/are-we-about-to-descend-into-mass.html): Ebola crisis commentary critiquing Deborah Peel's EHR safety concerns
